subject: Compliance evidence provisioning and trust-portal access for BlueRidge Health
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@blueridge-health.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@blueridge-health.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call

Thanks for taking the time today — useful conversation. A short recap and our ask so we can start vendor evaluation on our side:

- BlueRidge needs: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), a short bridge letter if the report is older than 12 months, and access to any evidence/trust portal for deeper artifacts.
- Regulatory flags: HIPAA applies for our pilot, and we need confirmation on data residency (US only) and Data Processing Addendum (DPA) terms.
- Next steps: please share who will coordinate security docs and send any vendor questionnaire link/attachment we can use.

Ben will shepherd the compliance review; I'll manage the procurement timeline. Can you share the SOC 2 PDF and a portal invite? If you have a hosted vendor questionnaire (DDQ), sending that would speed things up.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager | BlueRidge Health
laura.chen@blueridge-health.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@blueridge-health.com>, Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@blueridge-health.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call

Laura — really appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers and action items from our side:

1) SOC 2 Type II: we can provide our latest Type II report (period ended Nov 30, 2026). Because that report is outside the 12-month window for some reviews, we also provide a one-page bridge letter summarizing control continuities and any material changes since the report period.

2) Trust portal access: we host artifacts in a secure trust portal. I will request a portal invite for BlueRidge (role: vendor-reviewer) and send the link and temporary credentials. You will be able to view reports, control mappings, and select evidentiary artifacts.

3) DDQ / Vendor questionnaire: we maintain a canonical vendor DDQ in XLSX format and an online form if you prefer. Attaching the XLSX here for convenience.

4) HIPAA / Data residency: yes — Redwood supports US-only data residency for your pilot. We will share our DPA and a short note on our HIPAA controls.

Action items we will complete by end of day tomorrow (Thu 2027-06-10):
- Share SOC 2 PDF and bridge letter (if applicable).
- Send trust portal invite and usage instructions.
- Attach vendor DDQ and DPA draft for your legal team.
- Link to HubSpot deal and a tentative PO/contract path in case procurement needs it.

If you want to fast-track access, tell me the email address you prefer for the portal (Ben or you) and I'll set that up immediately.

—Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0132
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@blueridge-health.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@blueridge-health.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call

Thanks, Nikhil — Ben will take the portal access. Please invite ben.ortiz@blueridge-health.com.

We received the DDQ attachment earlier but couldn't open one of the tabs (corporate controls). If you could upload the SOC 2 PDF and the bridge letter to the portal that would be ideal — we prefer to review within the portal to avoid exchanging sensitive docs by email.

Also, can you include your incident response runbook summary and the name of the person on call for security escalation? We will include that in our internal audit packet.

Regards,
Laura

Ben — invite sent to ben.ortiz@blueridge-health.com with \"vendor-reviewer\" role; you'll receive a one-time access link that expires in 7 days. Portal link: https://trust.blueridge-health.com/invite/CTX-7a9f (also saved to the HubSpot deal).

Attached to the portal now: BlueRidge_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf, bridge-letter-2027.pdf, and an incident-response-summary.pdf. I also re-uploaded the Vendor_DDQ as Vendor_DDQ_BlueRidge.xlsx and confirmed all tabs.

Summary of next steps from our side:
- Nikhil: confirm DPA draft & share HIPAA controls excerpt (EOD Mon 2027-06-14).
- Aditya: provide a short technical runbook excerpt and on-call escalation contact (EOD Mon 2027-06-14).
- Marissa: coordinate procurement checklist and pricing cadence for PO/discovery pilot (will send a one-page checklist).

If you run into access or missing artifacts, reply and we'll escalate to support. Looking forward to BlueRidge's review and next conversation.

Best,
